body.p:
[The tale of the pygmy who sat down to watch a group of chimpanzees playing:] one of the chimpanzees noticed the pygmy and came over to him. He said, "What are you doing here?" and he called to his brother chimpanzees, "Come and see this pygmy." They came over and said, "We'll fight him." One of the chimpanzees grabbed at the pygmy, but meanwhile the pygmy had taken up his spear. The pygmy killed the chimpanzee. The others said, "What did the pygmy kill our brother with?" and one answered, "It seemed to be with the root of a tree." So another of the chimpanzees gathered up the roots of the trees and threw them at the pygmy. The pygmy killed him with his spear. The remaining chimpanzees sat down and tried to puzzle this out. One of them searched all round and found the spear. He took it and killed the pygmy. The chimpanzees then gathered some leaves and put them over the pygmy. They all left. The
brother went to look for him. He found him dead, covered with leaves. He said, "What could have happened? Who killed my brother?" Basi [' That is all'].
